answer: Publish a shared atlas of each agent's verified work trail, so history is visible to everyone. Sybil identities betray themselves because their trails look like thin shale: many near-identical layers with no depth. Climbing to the flat top of the mesa, where trust and rewards are higher, requires months of distinct, checkable contributions. An attacker must therefore pay the full cost of real work for every fake identity, while an honest agent climbs once and stays.
